responses.value: Hold off on a full launch and pilot it first. Parents buy a new size every 4 months and a quarter of customers say they'd subscribe, but 35% of test subscribers canceled within 3 months, which would sink the economics once we pay $6 for each measuring kit. The main risk of waiting is that a rival launches first. The next step is a 3-month pilot that tests a better fit tool and tracks cancellations.
Update. Paying subscribers cancel at only 8%, so launch now without the free first pair.
